title: Prorated lumper splits off by a cent vs. Hartline audit
text: Finance noticed that split accessorials on consolidated loads don't follow the largest-remainder rule we documented for Hartline. Their auditor recomputes every split and has flagged a dozen orders as off by a cent. On load TW-90412, a $185.00 lumper split by weight across orders of 4,120, 9,870 and 6,010 lbs came out as $38.12 / $91.29 / $55.59; the auditor expects $38.11 / $91.30 / $55.59. The totals are right. It's `prorate_charge` in `proration.py`.
